mostWorthwhile.text: Binding the encyclopedia brought the four studies together into a usable reference.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the studies one at a time was clear but repetitive.

surprise.text: The binding boards revealed named slots for each of the four studies, making the structure explicit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the placement and binding followed the chapter instructions.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the encyclopedia is used, though the repeated fittings made this chapter less engaging.
